why_old_system_looped: Only 6 images existed for 8.5 minutes of content — 6 clips × 15s = 90s. The remaining 420+ seconds had nothing to fill it.
explainer_video reused the same 6 clip IDs repeatedly to reach target duration — that is by definition looping.
No beat sheet existed — there was no story arc, no act structure, no lyric sync plan.
No Suno timing map — clips were not matched to song sections.
No participatory structure — the gap between songs and target runtime was ignored.
No editing pass — assembly tool received 6 IDs and looped them without any editorial logic.
diagnosis.root_cause: The pipeline went Idea → 6 random images → loop → deliver. There was no production architecture between the idea and the output.
diagnosis.fix: Beat sheet with 24 unique beats. One image per beat. One clip per beat. Clips used once. Story arc. Song sync. Participation beats fill the gap. No looping.
